parameters.name: Algorithm
parameters.description:
The type of encryption algorithm. Valid values:

- **NotSM2 (default)**: a non-Chinese cryptographic algorithm.

- **SM2**: a Chinese cryptographic algorithm.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query instance ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the paged query. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of rows per page in a paged query. Default value: **10**. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.
